fusions.name: Counted Strokes
fusions.desc: Strikes for 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Boundary Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the haft in a full circle, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and throwing each one back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Double Digging
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Old Hand's Footing
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and your armour rises by 6%.
